declare

 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 nullchk;

 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 into :coll_date

declare
 dummy number;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.product_code is null
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 :s_dummy_code := '%';
 else
 begin
 select c.product_code, v.product_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :s_product_code_desc
 from components c, valid_products v
 where c.unit_id = :unit_id
 /* and c.product_code = v.product_code */ --HCLC
 and SUBSTR(c.product_code,1,5) = v.product_code
 and v.unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme --HCLC 
 and trunc(c.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and c.product_code != 'NONE'
 and c.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and c.product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 :s_dummy_code := :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UNIT_COMP_ATTRB_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure unit_comp_attrb_query is
 dummy number;
 dummy2 number;
begin
 begin
 select count(*)
 into dummy
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if dummy > 0
 then
 go_block('unit_attrb_info');
 execute_query;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into dummy2
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date)
 and product_code like :s_dummy_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if dummy2 > 0
 then
 go_block('comp_attrb_info');
 execute_query;
 if :unit_attrb_info.attrib_code is not null
 then
 GO_ITEM('unit_attrb_info.attrib_code');
 end if;
 end if;
 end;
 IF dummy= 0 and dummy2 = 0 THEN
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 show_error('0175');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif dummy = 0 then
 show_error('0209');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif dummy2 = 0 then
 show_error('9003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
